thread:
michaela: Follow-up convo after RFC merge. Need concrete design for delegated-token revocation, billing attribution, and sampling rules. Two decisions needed today: revocation propagation semantics and how we expose original principal without exploding metrics.
arjun: High level: revocation must be near-real-time (sub-second ideally) for sensitive revokes, but we can tolerate eventual (~2-5s) for normal cases. Options: push-notify to edge or short-lived tokens + revocation stream.
taylor: We've got a lightweight pubsub for key invalidation; pushing invalidation events to proxies is low-latency (~2s in staging). For sub-second we could add an allowlist-in-memory check at issuer but that's complicated. I prefer keep tokens short and rely on pubsub for immediate invalidation.
emily: On metrics: we can't add origin_principal to Prometheus labels. It will blow up cardinality. We should not add origin_principal to core metrics; instead add it to logs/traces and to a sampled metrics stream.

michaela: Agreed. Propose: 1) tokens default TTL=10m, max TTL negotiable per-service up to 2h via policy; 2) revocation stream uses pubsub v2 with high-priority topic for immediate revokes (proxies treat those with higher urgency); 3) attribution model: "billing_actor" = operator by default, but token carries "origin_principal" in metadata; origin_principal only in logs/traces & sampled metrics.
arjun: For the revocation stream we should include revocation reason and a revocation_id (UUID) so proxies can dedupe. Also include an optional sequence_number to support ordered processing.
taylor: Agreed. Example event payload (compressed): `{ "revocation_id": "uuid", "token_id": "tk_123", "reason": "compromise", "urgency": "high", "seq": 9876 }` Proxies can apply immediate drop on high urgency, otherwise mark token invalid on next check.

emily: Sampling model idea: full traces/logs for admin endpoints and 100% sampling for error traces; for origin_principal in normal request telemetry, default sample rate 0.5% per route, configurable. We also need per-tenant overrides for customers who pay for detailed telemetry.
arjun: That fits. Add a per-tenant quota for sampled telemetry to control egress/billing. Default free tier gets 0.5% sampling, pro/enterprise can bump. We need an API in Console to set sampling_rate_override.
michaela: Implementation detail: token mint response should include `refresh_after` and `delegation_proof` fields. Clients use refresh_after to schedule refreshes to avoid parsing and reduce clock skew issues. delegation_proof = compact signed blob that contains origin, issuer, ttl, and chain. Keep it under 1KB.
taylor: Suggest proof format: base64(compressed(JWS(payload))) where payload is {origin, issuer, iat, exp, chain_hash}. Downstream services verify signature with issuer pubkey cached by proxies. Avoid full issuer call on every request.
emily: Important: when we surface origin_principal in logs/traces, redact PII. Use stable but pseudonymous id (origin_sha = sha256(origin|salt)) and keep mapping in secure store for audits. That way metrics/traces are safe.
arjun: So telemetry fields: `billing_actor`, `origin_sha` (pseudonymized), `delegation_chain_len`, `delegation_proof_version`. No raw emails/ids in metrics.

michaela: Edge case: background jobs started by a delegated call need a pattern. We should forbid token exchange for longer-lived work by default. If a background job must persist, operator must call an escalation endpoint which requires owner approval + audit. Documented as escalate_flow.
taylor: Also: refresh semantics. Clients should refresh lazily when token remaining_time < min(30s, 0.05*ttl) to avoid thundering. Add jitter +-15% for refresh timing. Provide SDK helper to handle this.
emily: For metrics cardinality control: core counters and histograms are tagged only by billing_actor and service; sampled metrics pipeline (clickhouse/bigquery) can ingest origin_sha at configured sample rate.

infra-bot: NOTE: pubsub topic `revocations-high` will be created in staging. Subscribe proxies: edge-proxy, internal-gateway.

sec-bot: POLICY: delegation_chain_max=3; proof_version=v2 required for new tokens. Tokens without proof rejected after 2025-01-01.

michaela: Action list: 1) taylor implement revocation event schema & add urgency field; 2) arjun add console control for sampling override + per-tenant quota; 3) emily write telemetry contract and pseudonymization spec; 4) create SDK helpers for refresh, jitter, and lazy refresh logic; 5) security: finalize proof compact JWS format v2 and key rotation plan.
arjun: I'll own console + per-tenant quotas.
taylor: I'll own pubsub schema, proxy subscription, and SDK refresh helpers.
emily: I'll own telemetry contract + privacy/redaction doc.
michaela: Let's aim for PRs by end of sprint. Quick call if anyone hits blockers. Thanks :rocket:
